2607.19678.title: Reference-Free Evaluation of Reasoning in Open-Ended Question Answering
2607.19678.paper_summary: AI-generated answers in high-stakes domains are often fluent but difficult to verify, especially when they contain multi-step reasoning rather than a single final answer. We propose a reasoning-based, reference-free framework for auditing LLM-generated outputs. The method decomposes a generated reasoning trace into segments, labels local premise-target relations using Natural Language Inference (NLI), and organizes these relations into a hypergraph. A deterministic backward AND-OR search then assigns segment-level audit labels that indicate how each segment is grounded within the generated response. We evaluate the framework in two settings: deductive mathematical reasoning with Hard2Verify, and open-ended medical reasoning with UroReason, a new physician-annotated benchmark of LLM reasoning traces from real clinical cases. Across these settings, our NLI-hypergraph audit provides a more reliable reference-free evaluation signal than direct LLM-as-judge baselines. In the clinical setting, state-of-the-art LLM judges often fail to identify problematic reasoning segments, over-accepting fluent but weakly grounded responses. Our results show that QA evaluation should account for how inferential relations compose across a reasoning trace, rather than relying only on final answers or LLMs as verifiers. UroReason will be made available through an API, and our code will be released as open source.
2607.19678.paper_summary_zh: AI 生成的答案在高風險領域中通常流暢，但難以驗證，尤其是當它們包含多步推理而不是單一最終答案時。我們提出了一種基於推理的無參考框架，用於審計 LLM 生成的輸出。該方法將生成的推理痕跡分解為片段，使用自然語言推理 (NLI) 標記局部前提-目標關係，並將這些關係組織成超圖。然後，確定性向後 AND-OR 搜索分配片段級別的審計標籤，指示每個片段在生成的回應中是如何被基礎化的。我們在兩個設置中評估該框架：使用 Hard2Verify 的演繹數學推理，以及使用 UroReason 的開放式醫學推理，後者是一個新的醫生標註的 LLM 推理痕跡基準，來自真實臨床案例。在這些設置中，我們的 NLI-超圖審計提供了比直接 LLM 作為評判基準更可靠的無參考評估信號。在臨床環境中，最先進的 LLM 評判者經常無法識別有問題的推理片段，過度接受流暢但基礎薄弱的回應。我們的結果顯示，QA 評估應考慮推理痕跡中推理關係的組合，而不僅僅依賴最終答案或 LLM 作為驗證者。UroReason 將通過 API 提供，我們的代碼將作為開源釋出。
